name: Sync or Swim!

pick.label: Pick a song
pick.heading: Pick a song and put it in an advert
lead: Every time an old song turns up in an advert, a film or a TikTok trend, somebody gets paid, and a whole new generation thinks it's brand new.
Choose a song and decide what it should sell. The worse the match sounds at first, the better. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Make it work.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Nobody is checking whether you could actually afford the rights, this is just for a bit of fun. Some matches will be perfect and some will only make sense at two in the morning. Both are welcome.

rows: Which song are you putting in an advert?
A real brand, a new product, a public service, something completely mad?
Thirty seconds. Who's in it, where are we, what happens?
The bit of the song we hear:
The chorus, the intro, one famous line, a key change…
Who should see it, and where? TV, TikTok, the cinema, the U-Bahn?
The slogan people will remember (or the joke).

values.story: Warschauer Straße, 1:58 a.m. A man realises the last U-Bahn has gone. The synths start. He sprints in slow motion past a Späti, a döner shop and three confused pigeons, and dives through the doors of the night bus just as they close.
values.bit: The keyboard riff at the very start, obviously. I'm not convinced anyone has ever heard the second verse.
values.who: Everyone who has ever stood on a platform at 2 a.m. trying to remember the way home. TikTok first, then the little screens on the buses themselves.
values.tagline: BVG. We'll get you home. Eventually.

yours.label: Your advert
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your advert in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which advert wins?
rank.placeholder: The advert, e.g. The Final Countdown for the night bus
rank.lead: Each student tells us about their advert in a few sentences. Add it, then argue it into place until everybody agrees.
